thread.title: J.P. Morgan Chase, Goldman stocks lead early Dow gainers

title: J.P. Morgan Chase, Goldman stocks lead early Dow gainers
text:
8:59 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Shares of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. JPM, -2.71% rallied 1.7% in premarket trade Friday, to lead the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, -0.50% early gainers, after the banking giant got the first-quarter earnings reporting season on a bright note. J.P. Morgan's rally was also boosting shares of Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, -1.41% which rallied 1.1% premarket to be the second-biggest early Dow gainer. The implied price gains of both stocks would add about 33 points to the Dow's price, while Dow futures YMM8, -0.52% rose 143 points. Among other premarket Dow gainers, General Electric Co.'s stock GE, +2.35% rose 0.9% and Apple Inc. shares AAPL, +0.29% tacked on 0.5%. Quote References
